post.title: Attention Residuals (AttnRes)  by Moonshot
post.bodyHtml:
Attention Residuals \(AttnRes\) - new research by Moonshot means they will become significantly better at staying on track during long, complex tasks without getting "confused" or forgetting early instructions . It fundamentally upgrades an agent's internal thought process by giving it a cleaner, searchable memory instead of a noisy, overloaded one.

Every day new break through. And it's been like this for the last 3 months- things are moving at super fast pace
